name: Sheraton Kuwait
positioning: Now Sheraton Kuwait, a Luxury Collection Hotel, in the heart of Kuwait City's business district, with a marble lobby, rooms furnished with antiques and Club Lounge rooms with executive lounge access
best_for: Business travelers who want to stay in the heart of the business district
Guests who want Club Lounge access

facts.text: The hotel is situated in the heart of Kuwait City's business district.
The hotel is minutes from Arabian shores, Liberation Tower and the Old Souq.
The hotel has a marble lobby.
Each hotel room features antiques alongside contemporary technology.
The hotel has hosted distinguished Kuwait City guests for the past five decades.
Rooms have a flat-screen TV, a mini-bar, a marble bathroom and plush bedding.
Executive suites offer stationery and a desk, suited to business travel.
Club Lounge rooms and suites include executive lounge access.
Rooms include premium bath products and free bottled water.
On-site restaurants include Riccardo and Alhambra.

considerations.text: Kuwait International Airport is approximately 18 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the business-focused atmosphere may feel formal for leisure travelers.
